description: trim projects.test.ts surface tests + heavy imports (broke auth-render via state pollution)

asi.important_finding: STABILITY BUG: with isolate:false the auth-render test 'renders the loading shim while session is undetermined' depends on global SWR/useMe cache state set up by *another* test file's imports. Removing projects.test.ts's RequireAuth/useMe transitive imports changes module-init order and breaks auth-render. This is a real fragility in the existing tests.
asi.next_idea: either (a) fix auth-render.test.ts to clear SWR cache in beforeEach so tests are independent, then re-do the projects.test.ts cleanup; or (b) add a vi.mock for useMe in auth-render so it controls state directly instead of depending on global cache state
asi.rollback_reason: checks failed: auth-render.test.ts > loading-shim test broke due to test pollution
